a4.decided: 2026-10-09, amendment A4, after the first report and before any A4 product was computed

inputs.operatorFilesNote: Every provider of the first run reads exactly the files its manifest lists (by SHA-256); ses reads every distinct captured file.

products.S: SGP4 from the latest element set (unchanged)
products.R: the resident product, called H before A4 (unchanged): the set's epoch state propagated by propagator/hpop's resident model (point mass and EGM2008 20x20), P0 and Q from the 2026-08 HPOP covariance model
products.H-epoch: every force below from the set's epoch state; Cd*A/m from B* in LEO, the nominal Cr*A/m; R's P0 and Q propagated with the full force model
products.H-arc: the same force model fitted to the epoch states of the 3-day arc ending at the set (analysis/estimation fit_batch); its covariance propagated with the fitted parameters
products.P: Planet only: SGP4 from Planet's own published element set (unchanged)

a4.issue: H-epoch and H-arc are made when their element set is published (its CREATION_DATE, at or before the cut-off): the arc holds the sets created by then, and the Earth orientation and space weather are those released by then. Like S and R they depend only on the object and the set.
a4.forcesNote: E7's table (EGM2008 70x70 in LEO, 20x20 at GNSS altitudes; Sun, Moon, Venus, Mars and Jupiter from DE440s; cannonball solar radiation pressure; NRLMSISE-00 drag in LEO; IERS 2010 solid tides and relativity) plus Knocke Earth radiation pressure (15 degree elements, on the same Cr*A/m) and FES2004 ocean tides to degree and order 30 (SDS 1.243.0 PRW). The table row is the object's gp-error-model regime (LEO, MEO or GEO).
a4.integratorNote: RK78. Against 1e-12 a 3-day LEO arc moves by about 2 m (1e-10: 21 m); MEO and GEO steps are set by the 300 s maximum.

bstar.note: Cd*A/m = 2 B* / (rho0 R_E), B* in 1/earth radii, rho0 = 2.461e-8 kg/m^3 (E7); a negative B* is taken as 0

physical.note: Nominal, not fitted: Cr*A/m (m^2/kg) for solar and Earth radiation pressure from a mass, a mean Sun-facing area and Cr, in round numbers from the operators' and agencies' descriptions. H-arc fits Cr*A/m at MEO and GEO (this is its a priori) and Cd*A/m in LEO.

starlink.source: Starlink V2 Mini: about 800 kg; two solar arrays of about 52.5 m^2 each (SpaceX)

iss.source: ISS: 419,725 kg; solar arrays about 2,500 m^2 (NASA)

css.source: Tiangong: three modules of about 23 t each with visiting craft; arrays about 700 m^2 (CMSE)

planet.source: SuperDove: a 3U CubeSat of about 5 kg with deployed panels (Planet)

geo.source: a geostationary communications satellite in orbit: about 3 t, arrays and bus about 50 m^2

gnss.source: GPS and GLONASS: E7's GPS value

galileo.source: Galileo FOC: about 730 kg; arrays and bus about 13 m^2 (ESA)

cryosat2.source: CryoSat-2: 720 kg; arrays on the roof and one side (ESA)

fit.weights: each epoch state weighted by the 6x6 RTN second moment (clipped covariance plus the clipped mean's outer product) of its regime's [0, 0.5] d stratum in model-2026-08-scaled.json
fit.covariance: the formal covariance times max(1, reduced chi-square), propagated with the fitted parameters and no process noise; a fit that does not converge gives no H-arc

drivers.note: Released at the issue time (E7's operational rule): IERS finals2000A rows to the day before, the last one held; NRLMSISE-00 space weather from GFZ Potsdam's observed Kp, ap and F10.7 before the day of the newest NOAA SWPC RSGA issued by then, that report's values and 3-day predictions, then the third day held.

a5.decided: 2026-10-10, amendment A5, after the A4 report and before any A5 product was computed
a5.requirement: owner 2026-10-10: "starlink should be fitted to the ephemeris and same with all operator data that has ephemeris"

pairs.rule: E4's object-files and cutoffs, restricted as below; results/e4/a5/pairs.json lists them for E11 and E9

excluded.esa-pod: definitive files issued after their spans: no file of the same object is issued before its cutoff; GNSS is covered by gps-precise and glonass-precise

planet.rule: the first states file captured on each of these UTC days

split.validation: objects whose NORAD number is divisible by 4

a5.information: the fit uses only the paired file; T_c is its stated creation (MEME created, OEM CREATION_DATE, CPF H1, Intelsat file-name timestamp), else its capture time; files issued after T_c are references only (the rule shared with E11)

extraInputs.spacex-starlink: the second captured file of each paired object, where the node holds one
extraInputs.intelsat: every captured file of the paired satellites

windows.unit: [past, future] hours about the cutoff, within the paired file's span
windows.planet: one state per satellite: EPH-fit is that state propagated with the full force model (Cd*A/m from B*), no fit, covariance from planetStateSigma
windows.choice: per provider, the candidate with the smallest median 3D error beyond the paired file's span (else within it, against later references or truth) on the validation objects; ties to the shorter window

observations.spacex-starlink: position and velocity, weighted by SpaceX's 6x6 UVW (= RTN) covariance at the epoch

a5.maneuvers: not segmented: one constant in-track acceleration per arc (the in-track fallback; estimation v2 had not landed). An iteration proposing a negative Cd*A/m or Cr*A/m ends the fit; the arc is refitted once with that coefficient fixed at its a priori, and the product records the refit.
a5.beyondFrom: the end of the paired file's span (E11's horizons; the same epochs for every window); Planet: T_c
a5.products: runs/<id>/products.jsonl (local): per pair the GCRF state and (6 + p)^2 covariance at the reference epoch, parameters and kinds, forces, window, operator files and the refit flag
